FROZEN_BASELINE.method: Exact rational Bernstein sign preservation for the COMPLETE 4-point oriented matroid of each swept triangle pair, augmented with all legal native simplex vertices; fully coplanar configurations additionally preserve every 3-point chart orientation. Constant oriented-matroid signs preserve finite convex-simplex intersection combinatorics and shared-simplex membership, including source-existing contact components. No face-family whitelist is used. Same-native-face fan pairs are explicitly included.
FROZEN_BASELINE.scope: Continuous mathematical linear path v+t*(amp*direction), with binary64 v and displacement interpreted exactly. Rounded endpoint checks are separate. Unchanged static pairs retain their prior status. This proves no NEW intersection combinatorics, not global source collision freedom or repaired shape.
